faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: How do I book a transfer?
items.answer: Use the booking widget on this page to select your airport, destination, date, and vehicle. Submit your reservation request and we will confirm shortly.

items.question: Is the price fixed?
items.answer: Yes. The price shown during booking is the final price for your route and vehicle. No hidden fees or surge pricing.

items.question: Where will the driver meet me?
items.answer: Your chauffeur will wait in the arrivals hall with a name sign. We monitor your flight and adjust for delays.

items.question: Can I book a return transfer?
items.answer: Yes. Select round-trip when booking and provide your return date and flight details.

items.question: Do I pay online?
items.answer: No online payment is required. You pay your driver directly after the transfer.

items.question: What if my flight is delayed?
items.answer: We track your flight automatically. Your driver will adjust the pickup time at no extra charge.

seo.title: Everything you need to know about Antalya Airport transfers
seo.intro: Antalya Airport (AYT) welcomes more than 35 million passengers a year. The most comfortable way to reach the coastline stretching from Lara to Kemer, Belek, Side and Alanya is a pre-booked private VIP transfer.
seo.imageAlt: Meet and greet service in the Antalya Airport arrivals hall
seo.imageCaption: Name-board greeting in the arrivals hall — included with every transfer

routes.title: Popular routes and journey times
routes.body: From Antalya Airport it takes roughly 15 minutes to Lara, 40 minutes to Belek, 45 minutes to Kemer, 65 minutes to Side and 2 hours to Alanya. Every route is door to door — we drop you off at your hotel reception.

pricing.title: How fixed pricing works
pricing.body: Prices are set in advance by vehicle class and distance, with no surcharges for traffic, waiting or night arrivals. The amount you see when booking is the final amount, and you pay your driver after the transfer.

comfort.title: Vehicle comfort and meet & greet
comfort.body: Our fleet covers Mercedes Vito, Sprinter and luxury sedan classes — all air-conditioned, with complimentary water and child seats on request. Your driver tracks your flight and waits in the arrivals hall with a name board.

meta.title: Privacy & Cookie Policy | VIP Transfer
meta.description: Learn which cookies VIP Transfer uses, how we handle data, and your privacy rights.

hero.title: Privacy &
hero.subtitle: We only use functional cookies required for the site to work. No marketing or tracking cookies.

paragraphs.0: At VIP Transfer we respect your privacy. This page explains which cookies are used when you visit our website or submit a reservation request.
paragraphs.1: Booking data is processed on our servers. We do not use marketing or profiling cookies in your browser. A limited cookie may be used only to remember your language preference.

cookies.title: Cookies we use
cookies.intro: The table below lists our first-party cookies. Each one serves a specific, necessary function.

locale.name: NEXT_LOCALE
locale.purpose: Remembers your selected language (e.g. Turkish or English).

noMarketing.title: No marketing cookies
noMarketing.body: We do not use Google Analytics, ad pixels, social media trackers or similar third-party analytics. We therefore do not show a cookie consent banner — we do not track or profile visitors.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services
thirdParty.body: Vehicle and destination images are served via Cloudinary (res.cloudinary.com). That service may set cookies on its own domain; we do not set third-party analytics or advertising cookies on our site. Personal data you provide when booking is processed solely to deliver the transfer service.

rights.title: Data protection information
rights.body: Under applicable data protection law you may request access, correction or deletion of your data. Contact details shared during booking are retained for service delivery and reservation management.
